notes.title: New Doodle God game is coming
notes.content:
Hi!

We have good news for you: we are making a new Doodle God game!

You may ask "Why do I need another Doodle God game?" The answer is simple: it's not just "another game", it's a NEW game with a so much beloved mechanic - mix and match everything and get your own planet. Now in 3D!

And we have the Big Bang theory in the game now.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1697770

Do you want to know more? Subscribe, add the game to your Wishlist. And don't forget to join our community:
Discord: https://discord.gg/Ep5zpS8Gvz
Twitter: @Doodle_God
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/doodlegod

notes.title: We'd like to hear from you!
notes.content:
[b]Dear Doodlers[/b],

We received plenty of feedback from you regarding our very first release on Steem. Lots of commentaries, mostly critical, on our energy system... The voice of the community wasn't unheard, and we released our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/625430/announcements/detail/1443823297795587497]Fateful Update[/url] where we totally rebalanced the energy approach that was the corner stone of your thumb-downs. 

However, it seems that our most recent update with a new episode and a DLC wasn't noticed because of all the hype in the very beginning :) So what we'd ask you to do now is to simply to play Doodle God Blitz and tell us what you think of the game. Are you having a good time? Enjoying the new content we added? Having fun with our fast-and-steady divine glow replenishment?

[b]We'd like to hear from you![/b]

notes.title: Revelations of New Episodes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29002788/001004bcdf2f65c43b254887efb36633e00e3475.png[/img]
[b]Behold, Doodlers! Turn your ears, fix your eyes, and hold your breath: great news coming right from the Big Boss![/b]

[h1][b]AWESOME NEW CONTENT[/b][/h1]

For those of you blessed with a quick mind and a strong desire to experiment, there's a [b]NEW EPISODE RELEASED[/b] plus a [b]DLC coming[/b]! The new episode is already available, and if you just can't live without doodling, you can purchase a DLC and go for it ;) 

[h1][b]MORE NEW CONTENT ON THE WAY![/b][/h1]

Besides, Doodle God is going to spoil you with [b]UPDATES EVERY 2 WEEKS[/b] now. It took 7 days to create the world, and look what mess it's in now :) So this time we're going to make this Universe right!

Enjoy the update and feel free to share your admiring reviews with everyone ;)
